newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Paladin Commercial units top turnover.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Paladin Commercial units top turnover.

text.p: Units in Paladin Commercial Trust topped turnover on the Australian Stock Exchange on Tuesday with 26.2 million units or about 11.5 percent of its capital traded.

The bulk of the trade was in two lines of 13 million units each, specialled through James Capel at a price of A$1.08 per share. The Trust said that at this stage it was not aware of the identity of the buyers or sellers in the transaction.
